title: A page is hidden only when the customer unticked it: no showcase rule, model judge or template hide rule takes a page off on WordPress, Joomla or EmDash
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/brief-wp-residue.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/brief-wp-kept-pages.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/brief-wordpress.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/brief-joomla.test.mjs packages/cms/tracy-emdash-theme-business/tests/personalize-hide.test.mjs packages/cms/tracy-emdash-theme-business/tests/personalize-pages.test.mjs
S2: Read the exit code and the fail count.
expect: WordPress: a published page no slot names (the email kit) and a page the model would not want (Careers) stay published with their menu links where they led, and no link is moved to the contact page; an unticked page is drafted with its translation and its menu links.
Joomla: a model answer that names entries to hide unpublishes none; an unticked page's entry and what only leads to it are unpublished.
EmDash: no template hide rule applies, ticked, unasked or never listed; an unticked page is unpublished.

selectors.emdash: templateHideRules in tools/personalize.mjs of the three EmDash themes

evidence: 08/10/2026: on dev the WordPress judge drafted a bakery's ticked Product page (tamq-7q-tbwp5); decision: a page goes only when the customer unticks it, pages still holding template sample text stay public and the customer is not told.
fence: Units over fake Apply doors and the templates' own seeds. Not exercised: a running site, the dev surface.
